claim_text: A vision of pots filling with hot food as people prayed over them, told alongside the Oral Roberts family story of groceries arriving at midnight, as grounds for expecting supernatural provision.
quote: steam started coming up from this hot food
falsify_match: Not applicable; the vision is offered as encouragement rather than as a dated event.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though the framing prepares listeners for shortages he predicts elsewhere.

claim_text: The Oral Roberts childhood story retold in full, with the neighbours refused and food arriving at the door at midnight, as the pattern for provision in what is coming.
quote: I told you God would provide for us
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is a story about the past.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Teaching to practise faith on small amounts now, while times are good, so as not to panic when hard times come.
quote: You need to put your boat into motion now
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is instruction rather than prediction.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Only a little window is left before freedom of speech from America to other nations is shut down, naming the Japanese, South Korean and Chinese channels he broadcasts to.
quote: there's only a little bit of a window left before they start to shut down
falsify_match: American-origin religious broadcasting blocked to those countries.
falsify_miss: The channels keep operating. China already blocks YouTube entirely, so the named case with the strongest restriction is the one that cannot change.

claim_text: Driving around in an open-eyed vision he sees poverty worse than anything in America before: tent cities everywhere like Skid Row, no middle class at all, and armed security around rich houses because of looting.
quote: There was no middle class. There was poor and there was extreme poor
falsify_match: Homelessness rising to a level where encampments are general across ordinary American cities and the middle class is statistically gone.
falsify_miss: Middle-class share and homelessness stay within their historical range. Base rate: encampments already exist in most large American cities, so scale is the only thing that distinguishes this.

claim_text: Streets that now hold malls and good restaurants become places where a woman cannot walk at night at all, given alongside a woe over America for the prosperity it was given.
quote: you could not be a woman and go down these streets at night
falsify_match: Commercial districts in American cities becoming no-go areas after dark on the scale he describes.
falsify_miss: Those districts stay policed and open. He names no specific street, so the claim rests on a general impression.

claim_text: People flee the cities in masses for rural land and places of getaway, pillaging grocery stores and farmers' fields and tractors, in scenes he compares to Mad Max.
quote: I saw people pillaging grocery stores, pillaging uh farmers uh fields
falsify_match: Organised looting of farms and food stores with net migration out of American cities to rural land.
falsify_miss: No such breakdown. Rural migration alone would not count, since it has been under way since 2020 for unrelated reasons.

claim_text: The church in America shown as a beautiful apple that is rotten and black at the core, with the rot only reached after several bites, and the wealth transfer limited to the one percent who sow at real cost.
quote: the fruit of the church as a whole in America
falsify_match: Not straightforwardly checkable: it is a verdict on the church's inner state rather than an event.
falsify_miss: No observation could refute it, since the rot is by definition hidden under a healthy exterior. Recorded as unfalsifiable in form.

claim_text: A shaking to awaken comes to America, with many current pastors shown the door and no longer behind a pulpit, and hidden sin exposed beyond anything seen before.
quote: They're not going to be behind the pulpit anymore. I'm done
falsify_match: An unusual wave of pastoral resignations and exposures across American churches.
falsify_miss: Departure rates stay ordinary. Base rate: clergy scandals surface continuously, so a wave would have to be visible in aggregate figures.

claim_text: Houses seized in the days ahead as people cannot pay, and Trump turning the printing press on with so much artificial money because they know the ship is sinking and cannot stop it.
quote: I saw uh Trump printing money. I'm talking like turn the print
falsify_match: A large new round of monetary expansion under this administration alongside rising foreclosures.
falsify_miss: Money supply growth stays moderate and foreclosures stay near their long-run rate. The Fed rather than the president controls issuance, which he does not distinguish.

claim_text: American debt is past the point of no return and tariffs cannot fix it, and a one world currency with a digital dollar will be ushered in that lines up with the beast system.
quote: America's debt and where we are is at the point of no return
falsify_match: A single global currency replacing the dollar.
falsify_miss: The dollar remains the reserve currency. Base rate: a one world currency has been predicted in this genre continuously since the 1970s.

claim_text: A worldwide humbling and a worldwide revival, with the glorious church rising in brush harbor churches and Holy Ghost Woodstocks in the country while megachurches are foreclosed on for debt.
quote: I saw a lot of them that could not pay the mortgage on their building
falsify_match: Foreclosures on large church properties at an unusual rate, with outdoor meetings taking their place.
falsify_miss: Megachurch finances hold. Some church foreclosures happen every year, so the rate is what matters.

claim_text: A rebuke that America worships only when convenient and limits services to half an hour, having been given more religious freedom than any nation, contrasted with China and North Korea.
quote: You only want to worship when it's convenient for you
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is a rebuke about the present rather than a prediction.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Closing prayer for revival over America and a shaking to awaken that turns out hidden sin and restores holiness to the pulpits.
quote: there is a major shaking, a stirring going on in the body of Christ
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: He reports China announcing a robot that carries a baby for nine months, priced at about $13,900 and planned for next year, as the fulfilment of what he was shown, and repeats that Hollywood will take hold of it.
quote: a baby that's being carried by a surrogate robot
falsify_match: An artificial womb product sold at around that price, and adoption by figures in the film industry.
falsify_miss: No such product ships. The 2025 Chinese announcement was a research prototype claim from one company and was widely disputed at the time, so treating it as an arrival is his inference, not an event.

claim_text: The bear's head inflates like a beach ball then deflates, after which the bear gains strength, and he is told a strong Russia is needed for the hook in the jaw of what is coming.
quote: You need a strong Russia for the hook and the jaw
falsify_match: Russia emerging materially stronger from the war and then leading a coalition against Israel.
falsify_miss: Russia comes out weakened and stays regional. The hook in the jaw is an Ezekiel 38 reading with no date attached, so it cannot expire.

claim_text: Russia wants to keep the land it has taken and wants Zelensky gone, with a new proxy government under an elderly man placed in Ukraine.
quote: The Lord used the word a proxy government in the days ahead
falsify_match: Zelensky replaced by an older pro-Russian figure with the occupied territory recognised as Russian.
falsify_miss: Zelensky remains and no such government appears. Both halves were already the publicly reported Russian negotiating position.

claim_text: He says the instruction not to strong-arm Putin was given in prayer beforehand, that Trump followed it at the Alaska meeting, and that he saw a diffusing inside Putin immediately as a result.
quote: You better not try to strongarm him
falsify_match: A durable de-escalation traceable to the Alaska meeting.
falsify_miss: The war continues at the same intensity. He is describing a meeting that had already happened and been televised, so the reading follows the event rather than preceding it.

claim_text: He repeats the art of the deal framing, that the stipulation he heard was that Zelensky has to go because he does not want a strong Russia or peace.
quote: the stipulations that I was hearing was he has to go
falsify_match: Zelensky leaving office as a condition of a settlement.
falsify_miss: He stays. This repeats the previous passage rather than adding to it.

claim_text: France, Germany, Italy, the United Kingdom and Canada want the war because their economies are in trouble and war is what funds and stabilises economies, and their representatives will come on Monday to tell Trump he is siding with Putin.
quote: France uh Germany, Italy, United Kingdom and Canada want war
falsify_match: European leaders visiting Washington on Monday 18 August 2025 to press against the Russian terms.
falsify_miss: No such meeting. The White House meeting with European leaders on 18 August was already scheduled and reported when this was recorded, which makes the named day a reading of the calendar.

claim_text: If the deal is not taken, a black swan event will be staged to poke the bear and uptick the war.
quote: a black swan event, a major try to poke the bear
falsify_match: An unattributed incident that measurably escalates the war and is later traced to a European party.
falsify_miss: No such incident, or escalation with clear attribution. Black swan by definition names no event, so almost anything could be claimed afterwards.

claim_text: The elderly man placed over Ukraine is described as sixty five to seventy with greyish hair, pro-Ukraine and pro-Russia, though he says this is only what was being planned and not necessarily what will happen.
quote: I saw an elderly man that was probably 65 70 years old
falsify_match: A Ukrainian leader of that description installed.
falsify_miss: No such figure appears. He removes the prediction himself by saying it is a plan being discussed rather than something nailed in stone.

claim_text: He contrasts the Trump he had seen before, arrogant and strong-arming, with what happened, and says only prayer changed the approach; Putin meanwhile is holding his cards and wants Poland and all of Ukraine.
quote: He wants Poland back. He wants all of Ukraine
falsify_match: Russian military action against Poland.
falsify_miss: No move on Poland. Later on carries no date, so this cannot expire.

claim_text: Major earthquakes and disruptions in the Northwest concerning British Columbia, which he believes will spin off from how the land of Israel is treated and whether a two-state solution is pushed.
quote: major disruptions in the Northwest concerning British Columbia
falsify_match: A major British Columbia earthquake following a move to divide the land of Israel.
falsify_miss: No such earthquake. The linkage means an earthquake anywhere near the region after any Israel-related decision could be claimed.

claim_text: A storm to the east over all of Europe seen in purple with thunder and lightning, sun on the other side, and an opportunity to diffuse it, viewed from outside the White House.
quote: All over Europe, I see purple
falsify_match: A crisis breaking over Europe on 19 August 2025.
falsify_miss: No crisis on that day. The diffusing option is stated in the same breath, so either outcome fits.

claim_text: Zelensky and the European leaders are throwing a fit over the decisions, and if they do not take the deal the war escalates very rapidly, in a vision he says has no fog to it at all.
quote: If they do not take this deal, I see the war escalating very very rapidly
falsify_match: Rapid escalation following a refusal of the terms.
falsify_miss: Terms refused and the war continues at the same level. He rates his own confidence unusually high here, which makes this one worth scoring later.

claim_text: Corruption in the finances around Ukraine, twenty four billion dollars, money laundering and big fraud, with more to lose if the war is de-escalated, and the war machine described as a money laundering machine.
quote: The war machine is a money laundering machine
falsify_match: A documented laundering scheme in Ukrainian war finance at the scale of tens of billions.
falsify_miss: Audits find losses at the ordinary rate for wartime procurement. Ukrainian corruption cases were already prominent in the news, so the direction is not new information.

claim_text: Banks, dollars and Zelensky in the middle of it like a drug dealer funnelling money, with child trafficking part of the same operation, and little girls with blonde and black hair seen.
quote: there's child trafficking involved in this
falsify_match: A trafficking operation shown to run through Ukrainian war financing.
falsify_miss: No such link established. This attaches a criminal accusation to a named living head of state on the vision alone.

claim_text: Children funnelled all throughout Europe and through the Middle East, tied to the tens of thousands who came up through the southern border and went along a highway by California toward Asia, with women involved as well as men.
quote: These kids are being funneled all throughout Europe
falsify_match: A network moving unaccompanied minors from the southern border to Asia and Europe, uncovered at that scale.
falsify_miss: No such network. The missing unaccompanied minors figure was a live political story at the time and is the source of the number he is reasoning from.

claim_text: He prays for the Epstein networks to be exposed all around the world and for instantaneous judgment on the men and women involved, that they fall over dead.
quote: the Epstein all around the world. You expose the darkness
falsify_match: Further networks exposed internationally on the Epstein pattern.
falsify_miss: No new exposures. This is framed as a petition, so a null result reads as prayer not yet answered.

claim_text: He is reminded of a virus he was told would come to Canada: a new sexually transmitted disease so infectious in the groin that sufferers are made eunuchs by amputation, sent because of what is being done to children.
quote: This new sexually transmitted disease that they would actually go unic
falsify_match: A new sexually transmitted infection first identified in Canada requiring surgical amputation.
falsify_miss: No new pathogen of that kind. Existing infections can already require such surgery in rare untreated cases, which would not distinguish a new disease.

claim_text: The new venereal disease spreads from Toronto into New York and Boston, mutating like COVID strains, painful and disgusting, with no cure and worse than AIDS, and it will be reported on ABC, CBS and NBC.
quote: it will mutate and it will be no cure for it
falsify_match: A named new incurable venereal disease reported on national American networks, tracked from Toronto to New York and Boston.
falsify_miss: No such disease is identified in that corridor. The named cities and named networks make this one of the more checkable disease claims in the corpus.

claim_text: Famous people will fall over dead in the middle of the act from heart attacks and strokes, naming Hollywood figures, sports figures and European soccer players, because the cup of sin is full.
quote: I see European soccer players, the football players in Europe falling over dead
falsify_match: A cluster of sudden deaths among famous footballers and entertainers beyond the usual rate.
falsify_miss: Sudden deaths stay at their base rate. Cardiac events in footballers are already well documented and occur every year, so only an unusual cluster would count.

claim_text: An exposing of child trafficking along the I-35 corridor is coming, from Oklahoma City up through Dallas Fort Worth and on to Kansas, and it will be on the news.
quote: An exposing of trafficking on I35 corridor is coming
falsify_match: A major trafficking case along I-35 reported nationally.
falsify_miss: No such case. Base rate: I-35 has been publicly described as a trafficking corridor in law enforcement and news coverage for over a decade, so the association predates the word.

claim_text: The I-35 exposing involves truckers and hotels, with many children rescued in the days ahead because of the prayers being said, and he says it will be on the news.
quote: An exposing of dark things of truckers. I see trucks
falsify_match: A trucking and hotel trafficking ring broken along that corridor with children recovered.
falsify_miss: No such operation reported. Truck stop trafficking is the standard framing in existing awareness campaigns.

claim_text: Major sting operations in the days ahead, with cities flashing before him: Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Tampa, Denver, Kansas City, St Louis, Chicago, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Las Vegas, New Orleans and Little Rock.
quote: These are the cities that are flashing before me
falsify_match: Large trafficking stings in a substantial share of the named cities.
falsify_miss: Sting operations stay at their usual level. The list is essentially the largest American metropolitan areas, all of which run such operations annually, so the hit rate is near one by construction.

claim_text: Amarillo and Albuquerque highlighted as well, with Texas college students named as part of what is dark there.
quote: I see Amarillo highlighted. Albuquerque
falsify_match: Trafficking cases centred on those two smaller cities.
falsify_miss: No such case. These two are more specific than the large-metro list and therefore carry more weight if they land.

claim_text: The venereal disease will make abusers too afraid to touch children, arriving on them without their knowing how, while children are supernaturally protected from catching it; described as an end time plague.
quote: it's like an end time plague
falsify_match: A disease with a documented transmission pattern that spares children.
falsify_miss: No pathogen behaves that way. The selective sparing is the part that could not be true of an ordinary infection.

claim_text: Prayer that God bypass Kim Jong-un as he bypassed Pharaoh, with a major revival in North Korea and the iron curtain coming down in China, and Cuba named as the country he keeps being shown.
quote: there'll be a major revival in North Korea
falsify_match: Religious liberty opening in North Korea or China to a degree that permits open worship.
falsify_miss: Both remain closed. Framed as prayer, so absence reads as not yet.

claim_text: Ahead of the Alaska meeting on the 15th he says Zelensky, Macron and the European leaders do not want peace but want to escalate for financial reasons, oil agreements and to support the euro and their economies, with Carney and Germany in the background.
quote: they don't want peace. I've already warned you all
falsify_match: European leaders acting to prevent a settlement for stated economic reasons.
falsify_miss: European leaders back a settlement. The Alaska summit date was public before this was recorded.

claim_text: He corrects himself that the trillionaire he saw is Emirati rather than a Saudi prince, and repeats Michael Saylor and BlackRock as the other two, three new trillion dollar positions in all.
quote: I saw in those three things three new trillion dollar things
falsify_match: Any individual or firm reaching a trillion dollars in personal or fund-level holdings of the kind he means.
falsify_miss: No trillionaire emerges. BlackRock already managed over ten trillion in client assets when this was said, so that leg is satisfied by an existing fact rather than a future one.

claim_text: Major sports teams file bankruptcy and people stop going to major stadiums, with the 76ers, the Philadelphia Eagles and the New York Jets named, all in the same area.
quote: I saw people not going to major stadiums in the days ahead
falsify_match: Bankruptcy filings by any of the three named franchises, or a collapse in attendance across them.
falsify_miss: All three keep operating with normal attendance. Base rate: no NFL or NBA franchise has ever filed for bankruptcy, which makes this one of the sharper claims in the corpus.

claim_text: Teaching that faithfulness with small amounts is the precondition for larger ones, using the ten dollar test and the hundred million dollar test as stages.
quote: If you do not be faithful with little, I'll never make you ruler over much
falsify_match: Not applicable; instruction rather than prediction.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Black onyx boxes stacked as pillars with a diamond beacon on top, one being the economy, and three individual men becoming the first trillionaires in the global economy: a Saudi prince, Michael Saylor and BlackRock.
quote: certain investment groups would be the first trillionaires
falsify_match: Three trillion dollar fortunes of the kind he describes, in those hands.
falsify_miss: No trillionaire emerges in that group. He names the Saudi prince here and corrects it to an Emirati two days later, which is a change of a named party rather than a detail.

claim_text: A 7.7 earthquake in the heart of India, the middle of the country, beginning a great shaking that spreads through Vietnam and all of China and brings a great revival out of it.
quote: a major 7.7, for this will be the beginning of a great shaking
falsify_match: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake in central India.
falsify_miss: No such earthquake. Base rate: central India is a stable craton with no recorded magnitude 7.7 event; the Himalayan front, not the heart of the country, is where India's large earthquakes occur. The magnitude and the place together make this the sharpest earthquake claim on file.
